snippet.title: THUGGING  Official Early Access Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up where all your friends are dead and you are broke in a drug fulled city run by thugs. Light hearted 18+ fun for the whole family. If your familiy is all grown up.

🔽Our Game finally released! Play it on steam 🔽

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3883250/THUGGING/

Music by Karl Casey aka WhiteBatAudio - The Enemy Method
He's an awesome guy, show him some love and check him out on youtube and bandcamp!

https://www.youtube.com/@UC_6hQy4elsyHhCOskZo0U5g
